name: ci-watch
description: Shows CI, CodeRabbit review and deploy progress for your GitHub repos above the prompt, and toasts when they settle

repos.title: Repos
repos.description: Repos to watch, as owner/name or owner/name@branch, separated by commas. Blank watches the repo the session runs in, on its default branch.

environment.title: Deploy environment
environment.description: GitHub deployment environment whose deploys merged PRs are followed to, e.g. production. Blank stops following deploys.
